segments.title: Post-Call Cast Transition
segments.notes: Case transitions from a collaborative call cast to the BIN nightly broadcast, managing dual-stream technical issues.

segments.title: Hype Train Derailment
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the feed for subscriber acknowledgments and a freestyle rap over a 'sensual' beat, thanking resubs and followers.

segments.title: Sub Goal Vote: Rescue Puffy Bear
segments.notes: Chat votes on the new sub goal; 'Rescue Puffy Bear' wins, committing Case to retrieve the bear from the Airstream where it has sat for over a year.

segments.title: Tim Walz Dog Conspiracy Investigation
segments.notes: Chet interrupts after 'scientist' trigger to analyze viral claims that Tim Walz owns two different dogs named Scout; concludes the conspiracy is baseless.

segments.title: Night Streets: Demons, Bread, and Bang Bus
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein fields opinions from a self-described hell-demon conservative, a lizard-person dog truther, JD Vance's dog, Johnny Greenbanes (alien encounter), Miles Taylor (transit YouTuber), a bread-man, and a Bang Bus operator.

segments.title: Wrestling Recommendation
segments.notes: Case gives the 'Case Blackwell recommendation' to AEW All In pay-per-view.

segments.title: Trent at the Movies: Trailer Mondays
segments.notes: Trent screens trailers for 'Super/Man: The Christopher Reeve Story', 'Cthulhu the Musical', 'Roadcraft', 'Boy and His Dog', and 'The Art of Eight Limbs'.

segments.title: Sign-Off and Raid
segments.notes: Case ends the broadcast after ~3 hours total (including call cast), raids Radmire playing Star Wars: The Old Republic.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the nightly broadcast, managed sub goal vote for Puffy Bear rescue, recommended AEW All In.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Co-hosted the sub goal discussion, admitted to a two-month-old mustache, claimed to eat worms for brain massages.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Triggered by 'scientist' to investigate the Tim Walz dog conspiracy, declared the story baseless.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train host. Delivered a freestyle rap over a sensual beat during the hype train, thanked resubs and followers.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Conducted man-on-the-street interviews with a parade of surreal park denizens including a demon, JD Vance's dog, and a bread-man.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: movie correspondent. Hosted Trailer Mondays, reacted to five trailers with Case and Chris.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Briefly appeared during Trip segment for a flash poll on cat names (Glenn won).

storylines.beat: [13:17] Sub goal set at 30 subs to fund Case's road trip to retrieve Puffy Bear from the Airstream where he has been abandoned for over a year.

lore_notes.fact: Has been in the Airstream for over a year; Case abandoned him there. [13:17]
Needs to buy Kendelle a cat before the 'cat mill' closes. [47:41]
Gives 'Case Blackwell recommendation' to AEW All In pay-per-view. [01:07:33]
Plans to start next week with voicemails. [01:25:50]

episode_summary: Case Blackwell transitions from a call cast into a three-hour nightly broadcast featuring a Hype Train derailment, a successful sub goal vote to rescue Puffy Bear from the Airstream, a Chet Guy the Science Eyes investigation debunking the Tim Walz dog conspiracy, a chaotic Trip on the Street segment with surreal park interviewees, and a Trailer Mondays movie segment. The broadcast ends with a raid to Radmire.
